disable_inline_scripts.description: Disable inline script execution for XSS mitigation. All JavaScript must be loaded from allowed sources defined in CSP.

policy.connect_src: 'self' https://*.stripe.com https://api.paystack.co https://api.flutterwave.com https://api.intasend.com https://api.paya.io wss://youngsend.com wss://staging.youngsend.com

content_security_policy.description: Strict Content Security Policy for Youngsend. Allows Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave, IntaSend, and Paya integrations. Blocks all mixed content and frame embedding.

uris.description: Primary CSP violation report endpoint (handled by Next.js origin)

report_uri.description: Report URI for CSP violations. Violations are logged and surfaced in the security dashboard for analysis.

permissions_policy.description: Restrict browser feature access. Payment permission is explicitly denied — payment flows use dedicated integrations, not browser Payment Request API.

strict_transport_security.description: HSTS with 1-year max age, include subdomains, and preload list submission.

hotlink_protection.description: Prevent hotlinking of images and assets from external domains.
